description: This Java class implements a SOAP client engine for invoking remote SOAP services within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages service configuration, parameter serialization, and communication with external SOAP endpoints.

classes.name: SOAPClientEngine
classes.description: A final class extending GenericAsyncEngine that provides methods to invoke SOAP services synchronously, handling configuration, parameter serialization, and response processing.

methods.name: SOAPClientEngine
methods.description: Constructor initializing the engine with a ServiceDispatcher.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Overrides method to run a service asynchronously and ignore the result.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Overrides method to run a service synchronously and return the result map.

methods.name: serviceInvoker
methods.description: Private method that sets up the SOAP client, serializes parameters, sends the request, and processes the response.
